rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for demonstrating that a claim is true or valid.

example.english: I can use the data to prove that this claim is true.
example.traditional: 我可以用數據證明呢個講法係真嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 jung6 sou3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this construction when something turns out to have a particular quality or identity.

example.english: The test results prove that it’s fake, so there’s no need to guess anymore.
example.traditional: 驗貨之後，結果係假嘅，唔使再估喇。
example.jyutping: jim6 fo3 zi1 hau6 git3 gwo2 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 sai2 zoi3 gu2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when checking or establishing that information, a document, or a fact is genuine or valid.

example.english: We need to verify whether the document is genuine before we can prove it to the client.
example.traditional: 我哋要先核實份文件係咪真，先可以向個客證明。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 hat6 sat6 fan6 man4 gin6 hai6 mai6 zan1 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoeng3 go3 haak3 zing3 ming4

rows.note: Use this for putting something to the test or trying it out.

example.english: Try this new pen; it may prove easy to use.
example.traditional: 你試吓呢支新筆，可能幾順手。
example.jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 ni1 zi1 san1 bat1 ho2 nang4 gei2 seon6 sau2
